mentions.name: Unity game experiments
mentions.description: A Unity game project in which the builder is learning the basics of animations, lighting, and movement, and experimenting with interesting combat variations.
mentions.source_excerpt: Recently ive gotten into Unity. Have made games before but always avoided engines. This time im taking a deeper dive and want to learn at least the basics of a animations, lightening, movement and lay around with interesting combat variations.
